BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

 IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF EL PASO                             )
 ELECTRIC COMPANY FOR REVISION OF ITS RETAIL                             ) Docket No. 25-00082-UT
 ELECTRIC RATES PURSUANT TO ADVICE NOTICE                                )
 NO. 317                                                                 )

                     ORDER APPOINTING CO-HEARING EXAMINERS
                           AND AMENDING CASE CAPTION

        THIS MATTER comes before the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission

(“Commission”) upon El Paso Electric Company’s (“EPE”) Application for Revision of its Retail

Electric Rates Pursuant to Advice Notice No. 317 (“Application”).

        The Commission appoints Co-Hearing Examiners Jocelyn Barrett and Elizabeth Hurst to

preside over this matter and amends the case caption, as described below.

                                          BACKGROUND 1

        1.      On March 27, 2026, EPE filed its Application, requesting authority to change its

base rates. Specifically, among other assertions, EPE states its cost of service demonstrates a $70.6

million non-fuel base rate revenue deficiency, reflecting a 50.4 percent non-fuel base rate

increase. 2 EPE requests a net revenue increase of $70.4 million and a weighted average cost of

capital of 8.35 percent. 3

        2.      EPE asserts that it has made significant capital investments critical to the

modernization and reliability of its system to address complex challenges, including: load growth

and electrification, transition to cleaner energy resources, grid modernization, reliability,




1 This order summarizes relevant background. The full electronic record of this proceeding is available at

https://edocket.prc.nm.gov.
2 Application at 2.
3 Id.
 resilience, and extreme weather. 4 EPE states that these investments and inflationary pressures are

the primary drivers behind the increase in costs for EPE to dependably serve its customers. 5

          3.    EPE states it intends to demonstrate that:

                a. its currently authorized rates are no longer just and reasonable, will
                   not adequately attract and encourage investment of capital if left
                   unchanged, and do not allow for reasonable return on investment in
                   public utility plant(s) and property;

                b. its rates and authorized revenues as presently allocated do not
                   adequately reflect the cost of service for the respective classes of
                   electric customers; and

                c. the rates proposed in Advice Notice No. 317, which was concurrently
                   filed with the Application, are just and reasonable and should be
                   approved. 6

          4.    EPE asserts its Application is based on a twelve-month base period ending on

September 30, 2025 for the test year consistent with the provisions set forth in NMSA 1978,

Section 62-6-14(D). 7

          5.    EPE’s Application requests the case caption in this docket be revised to include the

correct corresponding Advice Notice Number. 8

                               FINDINGS AND CONCLUSIONS

          The Commission finds and concludes:

          6.    The appointment of Hearing Examiners Jocelyn Barrett and Elizabeth Hurst will

provide for administrative efficiency and assist in the orderly and timely resolution of this matter.

          7.    The Commission may appoint hearing examiners to preside over this matter. 9

        8.      The case caption in this matter should be amended to better reflect the appropriate

Advice Notice associated with EPE’s Application.

       IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED:

       A.      Co-Hearing Examiners Jocelyn Barrett and Elizabeth Hurst are hereby appointed

to preside over this matter, take all action necessary and convenient within the limits of the Hearing

Examiners’ authority, conduct any necessary hearings, and take any other action in this case that

is consistent with law, including issuing a recommended decision.

       B.      The Commission hereby amends the case caption in this matter to read as follows,

which shall be the case caption to be used by all parties in future filings in this docket:

 IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF EL PASO                           )
 ELECTRIC COMPANY FOR REVISION OF ITS RETAIL                           ) Docket No. 25-00082-UT
 ELECTRIC RATES PURSUANT TO ADVICE NOTICE                              )
 NO. 317                                                               )

       C.      This Order is effective when signed.

       D.      In computing time in accordance with statute, regulation, or Commission order, the

computation shall begin on the date that this Order is filed with the Chief Clerk of the

Commission’s Records Management Bureau or the Chief Clerk’s designee.

       SIGNED under the Seal of the Commission at Santa Fe, New Mexico, this 2nd day of

April, 2026.

                         NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

                         /s/ Patrick J. O’Connell, electronically signed
                         PATRICK J. O’CONNELL, COMMISSIONER
